notes: Audited against current repository identity rules. Giant Storm is retained as Ultimate/Ki Blast and CaC-usable because it is a normal skill-shop skill; the GameFAQs character guide only establishes cast usage, while current community references corroborate its continued CaC availability. Gigantic Slam is retained as Super/Strike and cast-only based on its dedicated skill documentation. Gigantic Ki Blast and Super Great Ape Beam remain CaC-unavailable with acquisition left conservative where the available evidence does not establish a normal CaC unlock.
